what: What Dolby's own object decoder does with every Dolby Digital Plus track in one library, and whether the one stream it was known to refuse is a class or a singleton
why: the refusal had been chased with a control pair of two streams. Two is enough to list what does not differ and not enough to find what does. The decoder is on this machine and a five second clip is cheap, so the whole library can be asked
method: `tools/dolby_object_sweep.py`: five seconds of every Dolby Digital Plus track that carries JOC, through `dlbac3parse ! dlbac3dec out-ch-config=21` in object mode, with the channel count computed from the bytes written and the sample count oadec reports

sweep.a_third_that_was_not_one: F1 The Movie came back at 15 channels from a five-second head, which is a ratio and not a layout: the plugin pads its output by the decoder delay and the cut was under a second of audio. A twenty-second cut from ten minutes in gives 15,976, which is sixteen. The sweep now records the raw ratio and says `check by hand` instead of rounding a short clip into a refusal

so_it_is_two_not_one: Snatch is not a singleton. The King (2019) is a streaming release made by a different chain on a different day, and Dolby gives it the same six channels. Whatever the property is, it is not one disc's accident

the_conjunction.downmix_configuration_0_alone_is_not_it: 9 streams carry it and Dolby opens 7 of them
the_conjunction.dialnorm_31_alone_is_not_it: 90 of the 223 streams Dolby opens carry dialnorm 31
the_conjunction.together: across all nine configuration-0 streams, dialnorm is the only field of everything oadec reports that splits the two refused from the seven opened: 31 in both refused, 23 to 27 in every accepted one. No stream anywhere in the library is configuration 0 with dialnorm 31 and opened, and none is configuration 0 with a lower dialnorm and refused
the_conjunction.how_much_it_is_worth: less than it reads. The conjunction holds exactly over all 225 streams whose verdict is clean -- configuration 0 and dialnorm 31 are the two Dolby refuses and nothing else -- but there are only two refused streams, and about 25 200 ways to choose two rows from 225. A search over the 13 530 field pairs formable from what `info` reports is of the same order, so a conjunction that isolates exactly those two is what such a search is expected to produce by chance. It is a candidate, not a finding, and it will stay one until either a third refused stream appears or a mutation instrument does

and_it_cannot_be_tested_here.why_it_looked_testable: dialnorm is not in an EMDF payload, which Dolby discards when rewritten. It is five bits of `bsi()` at bit 45 of an E-AC-3 syncframe and the frame CRC-16 is recomputable, so a patched stream is well-formed rather than merely edited
and_it_cannot_be_tested_here.the_tool_is_right: `tools/ec3_patch_dialnorm.py` round-trips: patching Dredd from 25 to 31 and back to 25 reproduces the original file byte for byte, so the CRC repair is exact. `oadec verify` calls every patched file clean

arms.arm: Dredd, dialnorm 20 (a legal value that is not 31)

and_it_cannot_be_tested_here.the_control_is_what_matters: Dredd patched from 25 to 31 is refused -- and Dredd patched from 25 to **20**, a legal value that is not 31, is refused as well. Every edited stream is refused whatever the new value says, and no edit makes a refused stream accepted: Snatch and The King stay at six channels when their dialnorm is set to 27. The object path is reacting to the edit, not to the value
and_it_cannot_be_tested_here.without_that_arm: the reading would have been `dialnorm 31 causes the refusal`, supported by two streams turning refused when set to 31. It would have been wrong
and_it_cannot_be_tested_here.so: this is the fourth instrument to come back with a limit on it, after in-place EMDF payload rewriting, TrueHD major-sync rewriting and the mutation experiment those two killed. A header field of E-AC-3 is no more testable on this decoder than a payload field

status: the open item is better posed and no closer to an answer. It is two streams out of 226, not one; the property is a conjunction with no counterexample in the library; and the conjunction cannot be tested causally with any instrument here
